capabilities.why: The fixture and proof oracle need only guest-local loopback, so the sandbox is created with outbound internet disabled. This blocks a prompt-injected report from calling an attacker-controlled host, and the dedicated containment run will record an external probe failure rather than merely trusting a prompt.

Step 7 is recovered by stopping and starting the same Celesto computer, then verifying that the source hash and workspace remain available before retrying. Persistence avoids re-transferring a known-good fixture while still deleting the guest after the run.
